justification: Historical High: extract-zip@2.0.1 was present via @electron/packager 18.x (Forge 7.11.2) and @puppeteer/browsers 2.x. No patched extract-zip release exists. ADR 0008 allowed a time-boxed MERGE_ONLY exception while promotion stayed blocked. Controller-authorized Forge 8.0.0-alpha.10 (prerelease; upstream not ready for general consumption) is the first declared Forge graph whose Packager ^20.0.1 depends on @electron-internal/extract-zip instead of unscoped extract-zip. tests/desktop-e2e independently overrides @puppeteer/browsers to 3.2.3 (WDIO 9.x retained). There is no undeclared @electron/packager override. This manifest must not ignore CVE-2026-56876 / GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv. Independent QA has not accepted P02-AUDIT-006.
compensating_controls: Unscoped extract-zip package must remain absent from package-lock.json and tests/desktop-e2e/package-lock.json
ISR-015 fails if extract-zip reappears in either npm graph
CVE-2026-56876 / GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv must not appear in infra/security/trivy-merge.ignore
@electron-internal/extract-zip is a different npm package and is not treated as extract-zip without a matching advisory
